text_block_list.text:
Despite her illness, Супер Крик races in
the
Japanese Derby, where she
miraculously pulls
through and nabs first
place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I explain how I worked hard so that she
could win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then praises me with the ultimate

compliment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
